items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He was a drummer and singer in that group with Father Hines and Joe Paston and Bud Scott.

ctx.x: That's when Louis and I, that's when I left Jimmy Noon at the (Nest?), I mean at the Apex. Because I was subbing for Ollie Powells. He was a drummer and singer in that group with Father Hines and Joe Paston and Bud Scott.
Yes I see, that was after it became the Apex, after the (Nest?) became the Apex.
